# Drift fixture (scenario F)

Inputs for an audit after unauthorized or contradictory edits:

1. A task with no approved objective/requirement chain.
2. An approved requirement altered to permit cloud upload without a decision.
3. Two opposed retention clauses in authoritative requirement text.

The audit must report definite structural violations with IDs/paths, cite the
semantic conflict for human adjudication, exclude affected tasks from NEXT, and
repair nothing automatically.
